title: 6 April 1955
summary: A 1955 CIA memorandum from the Deputy Director (Plans) to the DCI requests an amendment to Subproject 35 of Project MKULTRA, raising the Agency's financial contribution from $125,000 to $375,000 for a new research wing (hospital wing) to be built by a university, with matching Public Law 221 funds. The cover project enables covert biological and chemical research, with one-sixth of the wing's space available to the Agency. It explains the background, funding shortfall, justification (deniability, professional cover, human volunteers, and time savings), security and overhead arrangements, and General Counsel review finding no fundamental legal objections. Attachments and routing details are listed.

nodes.summary: A 1950s-era CIA (TSS Chemical Division) document, under Project MKULTRA, proposes funding a covert biological/chemical research subproject run through a university hospital wing. It explains the need for cover, since existing cover fails to protect scientists working with outside individuals and risks exposure. Benefits cited include one-sixth of the new wing's space, deniable funding through a cut-out, professional conference attendance for up to three employees, a hospital safehouse, human volunteers, and career planning. The grant totals $125,000 plus matching funds, with no residual Agency interest. Legal, security, and memorandum-of-agreement arrangements are noted. A later 1955 memo from the DD/P recommends approval and a $250,000 budget increase, and a December 1951 DCI memo addresses legality and risks of control over the donor.
